name: Supply Chain Control Tower
tagline: Coordinates demand forecasting, inventory, supplier risk, logistics delays, and incident response in one operating tower.

orchestrator.job: Detects inventory, demand, supplier, and logistics changes, then routes planning, risk, and response work.

agents.job: Builds forecasts from sales, seasonality, and promotion signals.
deliverables: Builds forecasts from sales, seasonality, and promotion signals

agents.job: Checks stockouts, overstock, reorder points, and allocation.
deliverables: Checks stockouts, overstock, reorder points, and allocation

agents.job: Monitors vendor performance, geopolitical risk, and capacity.
deliverables: Monitors vendor performance, geopolitical risk, and capacity

agents.job: Tracks shipments, ETAs, customs, and carrier exceptions.
deliverables: Tracks shipments, ETAs, customs, and carrier exceptions

agents.job: Builds mitigation options and approval-ready response plans.
deliverables: Builds mitigation options and approval-ready response plans

reviewGates: Never print private data or secrets
Fall back to safe local drafts on failure
costGuardrails: Use standard or lower for collection and cleanup
Block repeated runs on same input
selfImprovement: Logs run outcomes, failure causes, and user edits into a memory ledger, then updates checklists and eval criteria.

benchmark.selectionRule: highest score, shortest wall time as tie-breaker
